name: winszn labs — dark Swiss OG card with orange slab by labs.winszn.xyz
description: A near-black 1200×630 card built on Swiss poster grammar: a tracked uppercase wordmark lockup top-left, a huge white grotesque headline left-of-centre as the single focal point, and a flat orange slab bleeding off the top-right edge with a tonal near-black square overlapping it for depth without any shadow or gradient. A thin hairline rule separates a quiet footer of letterspaced micro-labels, including literal hex swatches (#EB4604, #99A57D) printed as content — a self-referential designer's footnote. Hierarchy comes almost entirely from type scale (roughly 6:1 between headline and labels) and one hot accent against monochrome ground.
